plan.narration_reading: Same meaning-pinned spine, fixing AS-G5: every spoken section now carries a clip. Hook opens on the parched crucified face (#01), then king-at-scroll #02 ('David wrote it') and king-with-distant-cross #07 ('picturing someone else's death'). The David quote lands its objects: #03 potsherd, #04 tongue. The bridge now carries #05 (body sunk in dust) on 'a man sinking into the dust of death', and the jesus 'I thirst' quote section gets #06 (the crucified Christ, the dying word). The gospel turn maps exactly: #08 'made every river', #09 living-water-at-the-well 'offers living water', #10 'hanging there with nothing', then water clips #11 rock / #12 every-one-that-thirsteth / #13 drink-and-never-thirst. Hero #14 (pierced side, water and blood, glory) closes on 'that water is Himself'.
plan.red_team_notes: Moving #06 to the quote beat (P14) means the cross arrives one beat after 'John records the dying cry' (P12-13 carry #05); minor and acceptable since the cry-image still lands under the quote. #02 and #07 are both king-at-scroll, spaced apart and depicting different moments. Water clips cluster in the landing but read as building (rock/spring/drink are distinct).
